items.title: Ukraine to restart strikes on Russian oil refineries, Zelensky says
items.summary: Ukraine's president says a pause is over after fresh Russian attacks and US attempts to pressure Kyiv, while suggesting a Starlink slowdown is deliberate.

items.title: Why Starlink internet is so important on the battlefield in Ukraine
items.summary: It is the "backbone of military communications in Ukraine" that provides vital high-speed internet to forces across the country.

items.title: UK threatens to ban Eritreans over migrant return policy
items.summary: The home secretary said she would not hesitate to impose measures on other countries "refusing to co-operate".

items.title: Healey hails surprise UK growth as 'sign of resilience' ahead of Budget
items.summary: The economy grew by 0.1% in August, defying analysts' expectations of a slight contraction.

items.title: Reform faces criticism after councillors filmed making racist comments
items.summary: Reform says all of those people filmed by ITV are under investigation having resigned or been suspended.

items.title: Tiny critically endangered puddle frogs hatch at London Zoo
items.summary: The Afia Birago’s puddle frogs are a recently identified species from a single Ghanaian forest.

items.title: Hundreds of IDF investigations into killings still have no public outcome, BBC Verify finds
items.summary: BBC Verify has identified 254 incidents from the past three years the Israeli military said it is reviewing after being accused of harm.

items.title: White House defends new press secretary after questions about her legal credentials
items.summary: Katie Zacharia does not appear to be registered to the legal bar in any state where she has lived.
